dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: I'm in charge of welcoming guests, and of organizing all sorts of fun activities for everyone during the Windblume Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: A lot of the events are being held outdoors due to the large area needed, so without a guide to tell them where things are happening, lots of people are going to miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: And I, Lizzie, am glad to step up to that plate!

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: There are three events taking place during the festival: "Bullseye Balloons," "Floral Freefall," and "Ballads of Breeze".

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: As for the details... As opposed to having me explain, I think it might be easier if you try them out yourself.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: As long as the preparations for the activity have already been made, I can tell you where they're being held.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: May you have a happy Windblume Festival!

choices.text: Are there any other interesting things to do?

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: I've heard that the Adventurers' Guild has something special up their sleeve for the Windblume Festival.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: If you're interested, I'd advise you to look for an adventurer named Plauen. He'll tell you all about it!
